newsitem.title: USA: AEP Communications in pact with Sprint.
newsitem.headline: AEP Communications in pact with Sprint.

text.p: AEP Communications Inc., a unit of American Electric Power said Tuesday that it reached an agreement with Sprint Communications Inc. to jointly construct a 150-mile fiber optic line between Charleston, West Va., and Roanoke, Va.
The cost of the project was not disclosed.

AEP Communications said it would share the expenses to build the fiber optic line to provide its parent with network upgrades, while Sprint adds alternate routing and additional capacity between West Virginia and Virginia. The work is scheduled to begin in spring 1997.
AEP's parent, American Electric Power, is a utility company that provides electricity to 7 million people in Ohio, Indiana, Michigan, West Virginia, Virginia, Tennessee and Kentucky.
